content: प्रकर्षः .²1 Excellence, eminence, superiority; वपुःप्रकर्षादजयद् गुरुं रघुः <ls>R. 3. 34</ls>; वर्णप्रकर्षे सति <ls>Ku. 3. 28</ls>. .²2 Intensity, high degree, excess; प्रकर्षगतेन शोकसंतानेन <ls>U. 3</ls>. .²3 Strength, power. .²4 Absoluteness. .²5 Length, protraction. .²6 Speciality. .²7 Universality. (प्रकर्षेण and प्रकर्षात् are used adverbially in the sense of ‘exceedingly’, ‘preeminently’, ‘in a high degree’.)
